purpose: A reviewed design for adding projects with or without GitHub, and for approving work once and letting AIWorks plan its own steps inside that approval.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign writes the designs for workstreams #7 (connect projects) and #8 (start authorized work), each ending in small implementation slices. Design documents only. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

This task writes one design document only: no change to src/, tests/, scripts/, schemas/, registry/ or campaigns/. Decide everything that is not owner-reserved; list owner-reserved questions separately, each with a recommended answer.

tasks.title: Design: connect GitHub, local Git and plain-folder projects
tasks.outcome: A reviewed design for adding a project from a local folder, with or without GitHub, and the smallest safe build order.
tasks.goal: Write docs/design/PROJECT_CONNECTION.md for #7 (gh issue view 7 --comments), from docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md sections 3.1, 5 and 6 and the current code. Cover: the project record (stable owner-scoped id, source kind GitHub / local Git / plain folder, canonical root, governance binding, status Not connected / Needs setup / Ready / Temporarily unavailable) and where it is stored (additive SQLite tables or a file in the data directory, never credentials); detection and preflight (realpath, symlinks and junctions, nested repositories, Windows case-folding, ignored and secret-like paths, size limits); the managed mirror for plain folders, outside the source, and the baseline it binds; how config.json repositories and the registration gate (assertRegisteredTarget and projectGovernance in src/supervisor/campaign.mjs) evolve. Decision D2: the smallest Engineering Platform contract extension that lets an owner-approved local overlay register a GitHub-free project without weakening any inherited policy, as a proposed EP change in text (read EP schemas/project-contract.schema.json with gh api, read-only, or tests/fixtures/governance).
acceptance: Every statement about current behaviour cites file:line at the task base and is labelled observed; nothing is claimed as verified on the live host.
Each source kind has a connect flow, its failure states with exact owner-facing English copy, and a test list. Connecting never changes the source folder, runs git init or dispatches work.
D2 is a concrete proposed EP contract change (fields and validation rules) with the threats it closes; it waives no EP policy and never writes the governance checkout.

The document ends with numbered implementation slices. Each slice is one reviewable PR and names: the outcome, the files it owns, the tests (synthetic, no network), the acceptance, its dependencies, and whether it waits for an owner or Engineering Platform decision.
Owner-reserved questions are listed separately, each with a recommended answer and what it unblocks; no product question the plan already settled (D1, D3, D5, D9) is asked again.
npm run check passes; the PR states it is a design only and nothing is built or deployed.

tasks.title: Design: approve an outcome once and let AIWorks grow its task graph inside it
tasks.outcome: A reviewed design for approving an outcome once and letting AIWorks add and repair its own steps inside that approval, with or without GitHub.
tasks.goal: Write docs/design/WORK_ENVELOPE.md for #8 (gh issue view 8 --comments), from docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md sections 3.2, 3.3 and 5.1 and the merged docs/design/PROJECT_CONNECTION.md. Cover: intake (goal, issue, PR, local plan file, plan only) and how the read-only coordinator (src/supervisor/coordinator.mjs, AW-004) drafts a plan without registering it; the approval envelope (outcome, acceptance, write scope, providers and roles, optional owner limits, release mode, scope version) and its digest; how an approved GitHub-backed envelope still reaches main under AW-005 (declaration PR, review, merge, start) with a real owner-facing state for each step; a versioned append-only child-task amendment inside the envelope (schema, admission checks against unchanged boundaries, idempotency across crash and retry, fencing, packet digests, how it meets the immutable scopeDigest in src/supervisor/campaign.mjs and the work ownership of #5). Decision D4: the narrowest AW-005 amendment that lets a GitHub-free local project register a tamper-evident owner-approved envelope while executable code stays merged and pinned, as proposed decision text.
acceptance: Every statement about current behaviour cites file:line at the task base and is labelled observed; nothing is claimed as verified on the live host.

A child task can never widen files, capabilities, permissions, destination, release mode, limits or acceptance of its envelope; the document shows the admission check that refuses each widening and the test for it.
D4 is proposed decision text that keeps executable code merged, reviewed and pinned, keeps the GitHub main path unchanged, and says what evidence makes an owner approval tamper-evident.

The document ends with numbered implementation slices. Each slice is one reviewable PR and names: the outcome, the files it owns, the tests (synthetic, no network), the acceptance, its dependencies, and whether it waits for an owner or Engineering Platform decision.
Owner-reserved questions are listed separately, each with a recommended answer and what it unblocks; no product question the plan already settled (D1, D3, D5, D9) is asked again.
npm run check passes; the PR states it is a design only and nothing is built or deployed.
